required_preseal_precisions.resolution: For the intended actual-input theorem explicitly define Omega=R^N, P=infinitePi Exp(1), epsilon_k=max(w_k,0), stopped recursion and history; do not replace them by arbitrary probability/independence/distribution providers. The abstract iid-space version is mathematically sound under its explicit source input assumptions, but is a different public interface.

required_preseal_precisions.issue: Pointwise count gloss can fail on totalized zero-clock inputs
required_preseal_precisions.resolution: Keep E_n(T) literally the first n live records with0<T1<...<Tn<T, and E_0(T)=Omega. Call it strict first-n prefix. A count interpretation as at least n interior events is only AE on the good-clock event, or should be deferred.

Expand R_v p=p-2<p,v>v/||v||^2 for v!=0 and R_0=I; use Rec=(NNReal x phase) sum Unit and Hist_n=Fin(n+1)->Rec with product/sum Borel spaces. State K_n on the simplex subtype or specify an auxiliary total extension. Specify q as ofReal of the finite nonnegative product when multiplying ENNReal tests.

required_preseal_precisions.issue: Joint measurability quantifiers should be explicit
required_preseal_precisions.resolution: For each deterministic n and finite T>=0 and fixed V,eta, assert jointly Borel (y,r,z0,t)->K_n and q_n on E x E x phase x Delta_n(T). No regularity in V or eta and no joint parameter-integral theorem is implicitly claimed; add such extensions only as explicit outputs if wanted.

counterexample.target: Only an unqualified pointwise at-least-n-interior-count interpretation, not the proposed density identity
calculation: First wait=0 because L(0)>=0, so T1=0 and first bounce gives Z1=(1,-1).
Along the subsequent harmonic flow x(s)=cos(s)-sin(s),p(s)=-sin(s)-cos(s), hence lambda(Phi_s Z1)=max(-cos(2s),0).
For pi/4<=s<=pi/2 the integrated hazard is(1-sin(2s))/2. It reaches1/4 first at s=5pi/12.
Thus T2=5pi/12 lies strictly in(0,T): there is an interior event, but E_1(T) is false since T1=0.
counterexample.probability_boundary: The raw zero first-clock input is P-null under Exp(1); no positive-probability counterexample. It does not invalidate the unnormalized prefix law.

accepted_checks.zero_horizon: n>0,T=0: simplex and strict-prefix event empty. n=0,T=0: deterministic one-record identity, mass1.
accepted_checks.density: Product of pre-bounce lambda(Phi_delta(zprev)) times exp(-L_zprev(delta)); no post-bounce rate, terminal survival, factorial or renormalization.
accepted_checks.test: All jointly measurable complete-history ENNReal F including infinity; not merely endpoint tests. Hist dimensions depend on fixed n.
accepted_checks.joint_Borel: Flow/rate jointly continuous for fixed C2 V and positive eta; reflection with R0=I jointly Borel, not generally continuous. Integrated hazard jointly Borel by parameter integration; finite composition/product preserves Borel on simplex.
accepted_checks.induction: Define old-history Borel predicate A_n representing strict first-n prefix. Apply91 at deterministic depth with constant horizonT; integrate appended-history test and apply induction; Fin.snoc product-measure equivalence/Tonelli produces simplex integral.
accepted_checks.assumptions: Exactly six original analytic assumptions preserved; beta>0 follows alpha>0,alpha<=beta, so eta<=1/beta iff beta*eta<=1. No measurability, fiber-density, nonexplosion, support, integrability, positivity-of-event or coordinate-transport provider is a new premise.
